reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: § 12.4 as drafted binds only Customer, runs 18 months post-termination, covers every Vendor employee during the term, and bars 'engage' (an effective no-hire) with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out — squarely outside the preferred and fallback positions.

The redline lands on the stated fallback: mutual obligation, solicitation-only, 12 months from the end of a person's involvement, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and express negation of any no-hire.

The failed 'minimal edit' heuristic (0.839 changed-character ratio) is acceptable here — mutuality, scope narrowing, duration change, deletion of 'engage', and two new carve-outs cannot be achieved without rewriting the single sentence; no extraneous obligations were added.

Comment is accurate, correctly cites the preferred position while explaining the fallback taken, and correctly notes the conflict with § 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer made no no-hire commitment; tone and prefix conform.
